verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for an API client and testing tool, since such a tool could emit callbacks on events like run completion, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a consumer can subscribe to. CLI runs, CI/CD integration, reports and mock responses are adjacent features and do not deliver webhook subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
